Battersea Fitness & Wellbeing Gym
Sheepcote Lane , (off Latchmere Road) , Battersea , SW11 5BW
020 7228 4400
We're located behind Falcon Park, just a 13-minute walk from Clapham Junction, making this gym an ideal location for anybody that commutes to work on the Overground or lives in the Battersea area.
Opening times: Weekdays : 06:30–22:00;
Weekends : 08:00–20:00;
Off peak hours : Weekdays: 09:00-17:00, Weekends: Anytime;
Bank Holiday hours : 08:00–20:00
